title: Smallness of perfect restriction classes
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-derived-category], $f:Y\to X$ an open immersion, and $W\subseteq f(Y)$ an open of $X$. Assume $P_w(X,W)$ [def-pc-perfect-classes-small-on-open]. For any derived categories in morphism universe $w$ on $Y$ and all its localized open sites, the skeleton of the full subcategory given by $P_{f^{-1}W}$ [def-perfect-gluing-endpoint-properties] is $u$-small. This is the restriction image of perfect quasi-coherent objects, not smallness of global gluing classes.

source.place: Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star; Step 2 of lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set, using Tag 08DR

proof.text: Compose the inclusion of the inverse-image open with f. Mathlib image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf and W contained in opensRange show that this open immersion has image W. Apply the small-on-open property after constructing all derived-category structures on this open scheme and its further opens from the localized sites of Y.

For each site equivalence use Modules.overEquiv and the induced derived equivalence. A standard localization on the equivalent module category is locally w-small because it is equivalent to the given localization. hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall constructs the localization in w. Further opens correspond to opens of Y contained in the inverse-image open, and iterated over sites are equivalent to the single over site at that further open.

Exact restriction commutes with homology; restriction and the over-site equivalence preserve quasi-coherence. For each strictly perfect neighbourhood of E intersect with the inverse-image open, restrict its differential, boundedness and finite-free retracts, and use nested restriction comparison. Hence the restriction is a perfect quasi-coherent object on the open scheme.

Map the small perfect skeleton of the open scheme back to the ambient localized derived category. Every restriction class belongs to its range. The full inclusion of the restriction family induces an injection on skeletons into that small range; small_of_injective concludes, including the empty-open and identity-open cases.
